newsitem.title: USA: Danaher plans purchase of Gems Sensors.
newsitem.headline: Danaher plans purchase of Gems Sensors.

text.p: Danaher Corp said it has signed a letter of intent to buy Gems Sensors, a Connecticut manufacturer of level, flow and pressure sensors.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed in a news release and Danaher could not be reached for comment.
The plan calls for Danaher to acquire Gems Sensors from an affilliate of Constellation Capital Partners, which recently announced a deal to buy Gems' parent IMO Industries.
Constellation's principals include Danaher Chairman Steven Rales and Mitchel Rales, who serves as chairman of the executive committee at Danaher.
Danaher said the transaction is subject to completion of a definitive purchase agreement, regulatory approvals and a review of the deal by an independent committee of Danaher directors.
